bias.zh: 上升趋势 · 守住 30 日均线

read.en: TSMC edged up 0.2% on Oct 13 to $445.12 after a low of $437.40. It is holding just above its 30-day average ($443.7) and above the 100-day ($429.7) and 200-day ($393.2), but below the 5-day ($454.6) and 10-day ($462.9). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 9 and is above zero, Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 8 ($482.8), and RSI is 48.
read.zh: 台积电 10月13日小涨 0.2%，收于 $445.12，盘中低点 $437.40。股价守在 30 日均线（$443.7）略上方，并位于 100 日（$429.7）和 200 日均线（$393.2）上方，但低于 5 日（$454.6）和 10 日均线（$462.9）。MACD 自 10月9日起位于信号线下方，仍在零轴之上，抛物线 SAR 自 10月8日起看空（$482.8），RSI 为 48。

read.en: The 30-day average was pierced intraday but held on the close. Resistance is $452–455 (former $450 support and 5-day average), then $463 (10-day) and the $487.5 record. Support is $437–444 (30-day average and Oct 13 low), then $429 (100-day average, Aug 27 high) and $412.5 (Sep 15 low). A close below $437 would open $429.
read.zh: 30 日均线盘中被跌破，但收盘守住。阻力为 $452–455（原 $450 支撑及 5 日均线），其次 $463（10 日均线）和 $487.5 纪录高点。支撑为 $437–444（30 日均线及 10月13日低点），其次 $429（100 日均线、8月27日高点）和 $412.5（9月15日低点）。若收盘跌破 $437，下一目标看 $429。
